title: Clouds, a thousand years, and what symbolic language can establish
summary: A source-based comparison of clouds, Revelation 20 and recurring patterns: what symbolism establishes, what it leaves open, and where amillennial and premillennial arguments actually differ.

connections.label: Antichrist as a pattern of conduct
connections.context: A recurring image does not by itself prove that a historical pattern recurs. The clouds and millennium comparison separates the image, its referent, and the evidence needed for an application.

connections.label: Apocalyptic Repair Theology
connections.context: Symbolic language can describe consequential judgments and actions. The new comparison keeps historical recurrence, a final event and the ethical work of repair distinct.

connections.label: Biblical Antichrist Interpretation
connections.context: Amillennialism, preterism and recurring-pattern interpretation answer different questions. Compare the actual passages and arguments rather than assigning every symbolic reading to one school.
